_doc: Goldor (F7 P3) server block animations, measured from Better PF recordings (server ticks from chat n / st lines). frames: [dt, x, y, z, blockstate] with dt = server ticks after the event; apply on top of the library (arena start) state. Frames are those (pos,state) pairs present in >=50% of recordings of the event (ghost blocks, player mining, the 3x3x3 polished granite blobs and other client-side noise excluded). Gate and door of a boundary share no positions. Not event animations (see goldorCarve and tnt): Goldor clears an 11x11x11 cube around himself every 40 ticks as he walks the track (this is the 'S1 door barriers'/'S1 side' clusters and the y106 lava), and a TNT cube in the section in progress is removed every 200 ticks.

tnt.event: timer: every 200 server ticks from p3start+237 (observed offsets -10..+17 around 237+200k)
tnt.what: one 3x3x3 TNT cube (27 tnt[unstable=false] -> air, one tick) near the section in progress is removed per slot. Slot 0 (+237): S1 cube x99-101 y127-129 z85-87 in 49/50 runs that saw it, else x99-101 z103-105. Later slots hit the cubes along the track of the section in progress: S1 z85-87,z103-105 (x99-101); S2 x71-73,x53-55,x35-37 (z131-133); S3 z103-105,z85-87,z67-69 (x7-9); S4 x35-37,x53-55,x71-73 (z39-41, y129-131 for x35-37/x71-73). Frames below are slot 0 relative to p3start.
tnt.consistency: slot 0 cube at p3start +233..+243 (median +237/238) in 50/50 runs with it in view

goldorCarve.event: timer + Goldor position (not a chat event)
goldorCarve.what: every 40 server ticks (p3start +37+40k; +37 cube seen in 51/73 runs) every non-air block within an 11x11x11 box centred on Goldor (x,z +-5 around him, y 114-124) becomes air, in one tick. He starts at (80,119,40) walking the S4 line toward the S1 corner at 0.06 b/t, so this eats the walls/carpet/quartz along the walkway: the arena-dynamic clusters 'S1 door barriers (SE, P3 start)', 'S1 side', the S2/S3/S4 walkway boxes and the y106 lava removals (lava under the track goes shortly after the cube passes) all come from this. Implement as a rule, not frames.

ignored: client-side / player-made, not to simulate: 3x3x3 polished granite blobs (lib air, x2-18/x53-66 y107-127), single-block air->state restores near the gates (ghost blocks / Dungeonbreaker mining that the server reverts ~10 ticks later), early core-door/gold changes before 'The Core entrance is opening!' (ghost-blocking into the core), levers/lamps/target blocks/pressure plate and the SS board sea lanterns/obsidian/buttons during P3 (device logic; the SS board shows its first pattern and its 16 buttons appear ~+30 after p3start in 70/73 runs because the SS device is started then).
